title: Dividend Yield Calculator
description: Calculate dividend yield percentage and annual, quarterly and monthly income from any dividend stock.
howto: Enter the annual dividend per share and the current share price.
Enter how many shares you own.
Read the yield and your income per year, quarter and month.

faqs.a: Annual dividend per share ÷ share price × 100. A $2 dividend on a $50 stock is a 4% yield.

faqs.q: Does yield change if the price moves?
faqs.a: Yes — yield and price move inversely. A falling price raises the yield on new purchases but may signal a coming dividend cut.

faqs.q: Is a high yield always better?
faqs.a: No. Very high yields can mean the market expects the dividend to be cut. Check payout ratio and company health too.
